//@version=5
indicator("QB diagnostic expansion edges v5 valid length", overlay=false)
phase = bar_index % 12
v = phase == 0 or phase == 4 ? na : phase == 1 ? 1.0 : phase == 2 ? 2.0 : phase == 3 ? 3.0 : phase == 5 ? 4.0 : phase == 6 ? 5.0 : phase == 8 ? 0.0 : 6.0
windowAge = bar_index - (last_bar_index - 20)
w = windowAge >= 0
plot(phase, title="phase")
plot(v, title="controlled_value")
plot(ta.cci(v,3), title="cci")
plot(ta.cci(6.0,3), title="cci_flat")
plot(ta.roc(v,1), title="roc_1")
plot(ta.stoch(2.0,1.0,1.0,3), title="stoch_inconsistent_flat")
plot(windowAge, title="window_age")
plot(ta.stoch(w ? 5.0 : na,w ? 10.0 : na,w ? 0.0 : na,3), title="stoch_initial")
plot(ta.vwma(v,3), title="vwma")
plot(volume, title="volume")
